{"story":{"what":"Adds a GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute with an optional SurrogateType property. The source generator finds partial classes that carry the attribute and works out the formatted type from their single IMessagePackFormatter<T> interface. A new GeneratedFormatterCollector builds an ObjectSerializationInfo for T. Without a surrogate it uses contractless string keys for public read-write members; with one it takes keys and membership from the surrogate's [Key] and [IgnoreMember]. The formatter templates then write the body into the user's partial class, and the generated resolver registers it. Four new diagnostics, MsgPack019 to MsgPack022, are reported through a separate generator pipeline. The change also adds unit tests, execution tests and a sample library with no MessagePack reference.","why":"Requirement MP-2129 asks that a project can get a source-generated formatter for a type it references from a library that has no MessagePack attributes and no MessagePack dependency.
